name: Synaptics Incorporated
summary: Synaptics Incorporated develops, markets, and sells semiconductor products worldwide. The company provides edge AI processors, wireless connectivity, touch controllers, biometrics, voice, audio, and multimedia products for physical AI and robotics, edge AI, smart home, industrial and automotive, personal computers, and mobile applications, as well as modular development kits, open software frameworks, and optimized AI/ML toolchains.
